props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Selected tab on first render when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a tab is chosen, here or in another instance sharing the key.

props.description: Remember the choice under this key, in this browser and across every CodeTabs on the page that shares it. Omit to remember nothing.

props.description: Accessible name for the tab list.
